notes: Reports Perplexity closed a $500M IVP-led round at a $9B valuation earlier in December 2024, tripling its June 2024 valuation.

title: Mistral raises 1.7B€ to accelerate technological progress with AI
notes: Official Mistral AI announcement of a €1.7B Series C at an €11.7B post-money valuation led by ASML (€1.3B) with NVIDIA, a16z, DST Global and others participating.

title: Meta and Constellation Partner on Clean Energy Project
notes: Official Meta announcement of a 20-year corporate nuclear energy agreement with Constellation Energy for 1,121 MW from the Clinton Clean Energy Center beginning in 2027.

title: Constellation, Meta Sign 20-Year Deal for Clean, Reliable Nuclear Energy in Illinois
notes: Official Constellation release confirming the 20-year Clinton PPA: 1,121 MW, 30 MW of uprates, 1,100 jobs preserved, replacing the expiring Illinois ZEC program.

title: Amazon signs agreements to support nuclear energy projects including small modular reactors
notes: Official Amazon announcement of three nuclear agreements including the Energy Northwest SMR project (320 MW first phase, up to 960 MW) and the X-energy investment.

title: Amazon and Energy Northwest Announce Plans to Develop Advanced Nuclear Technology in Washington
notes: Official Energy Northwest release: Amazon funds the initial feasibility phase of a 4-module Xe-100 SMR project (320 MW, expandable to 960 MW) near Columbia Generating Station.

title: Brookfield and Google Sign Hydro Framework Agreement to Deliver up to 3,000 MW of Homegrown Energy in the United States
notes: Official Brookfield release on the first-of-its-kind Hydro Framework Agreement with Google: up to 3,000 MW, with initial 20-year PPAs for 670 MW (Holtwood and Safe Harbor) worth more than $3 billion.

title: NVIDIA and Intel to Develop AI Infrastructure and Personal Computing Products
notes: NVIDIA press release: NVIDIA to invest $5 billion in Intel common stock at $23.28 per share, alongside a collaboration to jointly develop custom data center x86 CPUs (with NVLink) for NVIDIA AI infrastructure platforms and x86 SOCs integrating NVIDIA RTX GPU chiplets; subject to customary closing conditions including regulatory approvals.

title: Intel Corporation Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 27, 2025
notes: Intel 10-K: 'On September 15, 2025, we entered into an agreement with NVIDIA to issue and sell to NVIDIA 215 million shares of our common stock at $23.28 per share for an aggregate cash purchase price of $5.0 billion. The issuance and sale of the shares was completed on December 26, 2025.' (~214.8M shares per contemporaneous reporting; roughly a 4% stake.)

title: Nvidia takes $5 billion stake in Intel, offers chip tech in new partnership
notes: Independent confirmation: Nvidia said it would pay $23.28 per share for Intel common stock in a $5 billion investment paired with a product technology partnership; CNBC reported Intel shares surged ~22-30% on the news.

title: SoftBank Group and Intel Corporation Sign $2B Investment Agreement
notes: Intel IR release (7:10 PM EDT, Aug 18, 2025): definitive securities purchase agreement under which SoftBank will make a $2 billion investment in Intel common stock at $23 per share, subject to customary closing conditions; Masayoshi Son and Lip-Bu Tan quoted on US semiconductor strategy.

title: Intel Corporation Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 27, 2025
publisher: U.S. SEC EDGAR (Intel Corp, via Intel IR)
notes: Intel 10-Q: 'on August 18, 2025, we entered into an agreement with SoftBank ... to issue and sell 87 million shares of our common stock at $23.00 per share. The issuance and sale of the shares was completed on September 26, 2025.' Intel's 8-K reports the precise count of 86,956,522 shares at $23.00.

title: Microsoft, NVIDIA, and Anthropic announce strategic partnerships
notes: Anthropic announcement: NVIDIA and Microsoft committing to invest up to $10 billion and up to $5 billion respectively in Anthropic; Anthropic committed to purchase $30 billion of Azure compute capacity and contract additional compute up to one gigawatt, initially on NVIDIA Grace Blackwell and Vera Rubin systems; Amazon remains Anthropic primary cloud provider.

title: Microsoft, NVIDIA and Anthropic announce strategic partnerships
notes: Microsoft blog: Anthropic scaling Claude on Azure powered by NVIDIA with a $30 billion Azure compute purchase commitment (plus up to 1 GW additional capacity); NVIDIA and Microsoft committing to invest up to $10 billion and up to $5 billion respectively in Anthropic; Claude to be available in Microsoft Foundry and the Copilot family.

title: Microsoft, Nvidia to invest in Anthropic as Claude maker commits $30 billion to Microsoft Azure
notes: Independent confirmation: Microsoft and Nvidia plan to invest in Anthropic under a tie-up including a $30 billion commitment by Anthropic to use Microsoft Azure compute; CNBC reported Anthropic valued in the range of ~$350 billion in connection with the deal.

title: Exclusive | Oracle, OpenAI Sign $300 Billion Cloud Deal
notes: WSJ exclusive: OpenAI signed a contract to purchase $300 billion in computing power from Oracle over roughly five years starting in 2027, per people familiar; Oracle declined to comment and OpenAI did not respond before publication.

title: OpenAI, Oracle, and SoftBank expand Stargate with five new AI data center sites
notes: OpenAI on the record: the July 4.5 GW Oracle agreement "represents a partnership that exceeds $300 billion between the two companies over the next five years," with the new Oracle Stargate sites delivering over 5.5 GW.

title: The next chapter of the Microsoft–OpenAI partnership
notes: Microsoft blog: "OpenAI has contracted to purchase an incremental $250B of Azure services, and Microsoft will no longer have a right of first refusal to be OpenAI’s compute provider." Part of the definitive next-phase agreement.

title: The next chapter of the Microsoft–OpenAI partnership
notes: OpenAI blog co-announcement of the new definitive agreement including the incremental $250B Azure services purchase commitment.

title: Microsoft, NVIDIA, and Anthropic announce strategic partnerships
notes: Joint announcement: "Anthropic has committed to purchase $30 billion of Azure compute capacity and to contract additional compute capacity up to one gigawatt" on NVIDIA Grace Blackwell and Vera Rubin systems.

title: Microsoft, Nvidia to invest in Anthropic as Claude maker commits $30 billion to Microsoft Azure
notes: Reuters confirmation of the three-way tie-up including the $30 billion Anthropic commitment to Microsoft Azure compute.

title: Meta signs over $10 billion cloud deal with Google, source says
notes: Reuters: Meta has struck a six-year cloud computing deal with Google worth more than $10 billion, per two people familiar; first reported by The Information; deal is mainly AI infrastructure. Neither company officially confirmed.

title: CoreWeave, Inc. Current Report on Form 8-K (Meta Order Form under Master Services Agreement)
notes: CoreWeave 8-K (Items 1.01/9.01): on September 25, 2025 Meta entered a new order form under the December 10, 2023 MSA committing "up to approximately $14.2 billion through December 14, 2031," with the option to materially expand its commitment through 2032; redacted Meta MSA filed as Exhibit 10.1.

title: TeraWulf Inc. Current Report on Form 8-K (Fluidstack leases, Google backstop and warrants)
notes: 8-K Item 1.01: Aug 13, 2025 Recognition Agreements (Akela Data LLC, Fluidstack USA I, Google LLC) for Google BackStop of Fluidstack lease obligations; Warrant Agreements issuing Google warrants for 41,011,803 shares at $0.01 exercise, pledged to project lenders until the backstop becomes effective.

title: TeraWulf Signs 200+ MW, 10-Year AI Hosting Agreements with Fluidstack
notes: Company release: two 10-year HPC colocation leases for 200+ MW critical IT load (~250 MW gross) at Lake Mariner; ~$3.7B contracted revenue over initial term (~$8.7B with extensions); Google backstops $1.8B of Fluidstack lease obligations for ~8% equity via ~41M warrants.

title: TeraWulf 8-K Exhibit 99.1: Fluidstack Expansion with 160 MW CB-5 Lease at Lake Mariner
notes: CB-5 lease (Aug 17 agreements; 32,568,197 incremental warrants): incremental $1.4B backstop takes Google total to ~$3.2B and pro forma equity ownership to ~14%; total Fluidstack contracted capacity ~360 MW and ~$6.7B contracted revenue (~$16B with extensions).

title: Cipher Mining 8-K Exhibit 99.1: 168 MW, 10-Year AI Hosting Agreement with Fluidstack
notes: Cipher press release filed as 8-K exhibit: 10-year lease for 168 MW critical IT load at Barber Lake (Colorado City, TX); ~$3.0B contracted revenue (~$7B with extensions); Google backstops $1.4B of Fluidstack lease obligations for warrants on ~24M shares (~5.4% pro forma); Morgan Stanley sole financial advisor.

title: Cipher Mining 8-K Exhibit 99.1: Additional 56 MW, 10-Year AI Hosting Agreement with Fluidstack
notes: Expansion 8-K exhibit: additional 39 MW critical IT load (56 MW gross) takes Fluidstack to the full 300 MW Barber Lake site; ~$830M added contracted revenue (~$3.8B partnership total initial term); Google backstop expanded by $333M to $1.73B total via Amended & Restated Recognition Agreement.

title: Cursor — Series C and Scale
notes: Company announcement: $900 million at a $9.9 billion valuation from Thrive, Accel, Andreessen Horowitz, and DST; Cursor past $500M ARR and used by over half the Fortune 500 including NVIDIA, Uber, and Adobe.

title: Cursor's Anysphere nabs $9.9B valuation, soars past $500M ARR
notes: TechCrunch (citing Bloomberg): $900M raised at $9.9B valuation, led by returning investor Thrive Capital with participation from Andreessen Horowitz, Accel, and DST Global.

title: Musk's xAI nears $20 billion capital raise tied to Nvidia chips, Bloomberg News reports
notes: Reuters relay of Bloomberg (Oct 7-8, 2025): financing lifted to ~$20B via an SPV that buys NVIDIA processors and rents them to xAI for Colossus 2 in Memphis; split of ~$7.5B equity and up to $12.5B SPV debt; NVIDIA investing as much as $2B in the equity portion; Valor leading equity; Apollo and Diameter participating in the debt.

title: Google Completes Acquisition of Wiz
notes: Official Google announcement of the completed $32B all-cash Wiz acquisition closing March 11, 2026 (deal initially announced March 2025); Wiz joins Google Cloud and keeps its brand and multicloud support.

title: Press Release of Alphabet Inc. dated March 18, 2025 (SEC EDGAR Exhibit 99.1)
notes: Alphabet 8-K exhibit announcing the definitive agreement signed March 18, 2025 to acquire Wiz, Inc. for $32 billion, subject to closing adjustments, in an all-cash transaction.

title: A letter from Sam & Jony
notes: Official OpenAI letter (May 21, 2025) announcing io Products, Inc. merging with OpenAI; page update of July 9, 2025 confirms the io team officially merged with OpenAI while LoveFrom remains independent.

title: OpenAI Unites With Jony Ive in $6.5 Billion Deal to Create A.I. Devices
notes: Reports OpenAI paying $6.5B in an all-stock purchase of io, the one-year-old startup founded by Jony Ive, with roughly 55 employees joining; corroborated by Bloomberg, WSJ and TechCrunch same-day coverage.

title: Google hires Windsurf CEO Varun Mohan, others in $2.4 billion AI talent deal
notes: Reports Google’s agreement to hire Windsurf co-founder/CEO Varun Mohan, co-founder Douglas Chen and senior R&D staff into Google DeepMind, with a ~$2.4B payment covering a non-exclusive Windsurf technology license and compensation; Google takes no equity.

title: Acquisition of Ampere Computing Holdings LLC
notes: Official SBG release: agreement entered March 19, 2025 (U.S. time) to acquire all equity of Ampere Computing Holdings for $6.5B (approx. JPY 973.0B) in cash via subsidiary Silver Bands 6 (US) Corp., making Ampere an indirect wholly owned SBG subsidiary; Carlyle and Oracle selling their positions.

title: Completion of Acquisition of Ampere Computing Holdings LLC
notes: Official completion release mirroring SBG’s November 26, 2025 announcement: closing occurred November 25, 2025 (U.S. time), when Ampere became a wholly owned SBG subsidiary through Silver Bands 6 (US) Corp.

title: Nvidia buying AI chip startup Groq’s assets for about $20 billion, its largest deal on record
notes: First reported (exclusive) NVIDIA’s ~$20B payment to acquire most of Groq’s assets in its largest deal ever - a license-plus-hire of the rival inference-chip maker’s technology and leadership rather than an equity acquisition.

title: Groq and Nvidia Enter Non-Exclusive Inference Technology Licensing Agreement
notes: Official Groq announcement (December 24, 2025): non-exclusive licensing agreement with NVIDIA over Groq’s inference technology; founder Jonathan Ross and president Sunny Madra plus team members join NVIDIA; Groq continues as an independent company with Simon Edwards as CEO and GroqCloud operating uninterrupted.

title: Google hires top talent from startup Character.AI, signs licensing deal
notes: Reports Character.AI signed a non-exclusive license of its LLM technology to Google with co-founders Noam Shazeer and Daniel De Freitas rejoining Google DeepMind; structured so no company shares change hands.

title: Stripe agrees to acquire OpenRouter to help businesses optimize token routing and usage
notes: Official Stripe announcement that it agrees to acquire OpenRouter; CEO Patrick Collison quoted on building the economic infrastructure for AI. Terms not disclosed in the release.

title: OpenRouter is Joining Stripe
notes: OpenRouter's own announcement of joining Stripe; states 10+ trillion tokens processed daily across 400+ models and 10M+ developers, with 10x yearly growth in inference volume.

title: Stripe Buys A.I. Start-Up OpenRouter for $7.5 Billion
notes: NYT reports a ~$7.5B price tag citing a person familiar ($1.5B allocated to OpenRouter founders); Stripe officially declined to disclose terms — reported figures stay out of the ledger amount.
